story: Tank drinks from the endless metronome beats and grows beyond its normal limit, while metronome still rises but is diverted into feeding the tank.
Needle acts as a predator, eating the rabbit population; rabbits decline while the needle rises and settles at a sustainable level.
Rubber band pulls rabbits and needle toward each other; they meet and settle at equilibrium in the middle.
Tank drains the rabbit population as it eats them; rabbits decline while the tank grows beyond its normal level.
Rubber band couples weight's swing with rabbits' growth; weight's swing dampens upward, rabbits settle lower, and they meet at a middle state.
Tank's water feeds starving foxes; foxes stabilize at a sustainable level instead of dying out, while tank is slowly depleted.
Rabbits and chooser both naturally reach 1; the rubber band simply reinforces their alignment and both settle together.
Tank watches and follows weight's swinging motion, oscillating instead of filling to a steady level, while weight swings unaffected.
Foxes and chooser sync in step; foxes stop dying out and swing with the chooser, while chooser wavers instead of deciding, maintaining a rhythm together.
Metronome's endless rise is held back by synchronizing with rabbits; metronome settles into a steady rhythm at the rabbit's level.
Metronome watches tank and drifts toward it, settling at the tank's level instead of rising forever, while tank stays unaffected.
Rabbits eat into the chooser's conviction; chooser's preference weakens and dies out as rabbits feed on them, while rabbits persist.
